title: Fakey Frogs
description: Turn your frogs and tadpoles into lovely Fakeys and Fakelings!
body:
hello there, if you've stumbled your way here through Tumblr then there's a good chance that you're here for some _high quality_ **Fakey Frogs™**-
well trouble yourself no more friend! these Fakey Frogs are of the highest quality that I can achieve thanks to Paint.net editing skills! fully immerse yourself in the world of Minecraft with these happy, croaking, hopping Fakeys. feed them slime, give them hugs and pets, bring 100 of them into your home.
